The work is partnering with account executives, advising enterprise customers, creating technical content for executives, and occasional travel to customer sites. It is not a hands-on ML/NLP/AI engineering role where the main work is building, training, and deploying systems, so it does not match her target roles (ML Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, Research Engineer). Her background is an MS in CS (AI) in progress at Boston University and one ML Engineer co-op, so she does not meet these. The '5+ years' item is listed only as preferred, so the rejection does not rest on it. (4) Skills: The minimum qualifications name fewer than 2 specific technologies (Python appears only as a preferred qualification), so the skills test is skipped. (5) Sponsorship: Anthropic states 'We do sponsor visas!', so sponsorship is not a blocker. However, the role type and location failures alone make this NOT_RELEVANT.
